systems.system: birth registration integrated into the Mother and Child Cash Transfer Plus (MCCT+) programme
systems.tiers: Red Sea and Kassala states: in 2025, 13,496 children under two benefited and 1,312 received birth certificates, by UNICEF's count

note: A UNICEF humanitarian report for 2025: it says birth registration stayed underfunded and was folded into a cash-transfer programme, and states nothing about how or where a civil registration office makes its record.
